# Matan Kidrony | מתן קידרוני

> Matan Kidrony (מתן קידרוני) is a product and brand designer and design partner for startups in Israel. He is a creative and design leader with 15+ years of experience and 100+ founders and teams worked with. He offers brand identity, product design (UX/UI), design systems, and fractional Head of Design work.

Contact: matankidrony@gmail.com · LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/matankidrony · Portfolio: https://matan.design

## Case studies
- [Home and overview](https://kidmatik.github.io/portfolio/): profile, services, selected work, About, testimonials and contact
- [Wideview.io](https://kidmatik.github.io/portfolio/wideview/): UX/UI product design, a decision-making system for eCommerce executives
- [Cymbio](https://kidmatik.github.io/portfolio/cymbio/): full brand rebrand, logo, visual language, marketing and website (acquired by PayPal)
- [Voca.ai](https://kidmatik.github.io/portfolio/voca/): brand identity, illustration system, website and motion (acquired by Snap)
- [Picabook](https://kidmatik.github.io/portfolio/picabook/): bilingual brand identity, illustrations, website, packaging and print
